title: Evolution of Recurrent Myxofibrosarcoma of the Thoracic Wall at Single-Cell Resolution: A Case Report.
snippet: Myxofibrosarcoma (MFS) is a common yet understudied type of soft tissue sarcoma. It is characterized by diverse cellular morphology, unusual growth patterns, and a propensity for local tumor recurrences.
